question: Can the preregistered warmup and changed-action qualification inputs be reproduced without new tokenization, Eval access, or manual prompt changes?
controls: Preserve exact previously measured prompts, token counts, output caps, model and tokenizer identity.
Warmup chooses the first Train request of each token class 256/1024/3072, at offsets 0/1/2 seconds.
Qualification uses the first four Train requests at offsets 0.25/1.25/2.25/3.25 seconds in a five-second envelope.
Declare purpose engineering, not held-out or performance comparison.
Reject any changed input bytes and never overwrite an existing output directory.
scope_exclusions: No Eval reading, inference, HTTP, SSH, GPU access, servers, fitting or permit generation.
No evidence of closed-loop application, prediction accuracy or benchmark performance.
